text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The law association backed recent salary increases for judges, saying they would help to increase confidence and avert corruption in the judiciary.
- Paramilitary police sealed off the University of Zambia and barred striking workers from entering the campus on Thursday.
- Public transport services announced a 25 percent increase in bus fares, following a 24 percent fuel price hike announced this week.
- Belgium said it would maintain direct bilateral aid to Zambia.
